description: Authoritative database migration rollback compatibility manifest. Defines backward compatibility and application rollback safety for all applied Prisma migrations.

migrations.description: Initial production baseline schema: users, bills, transactions, rewards, KYC, audits.
Additive tables and columns for profession separation and dynamic business rules.
Adds unique index on billFileHash to prevent duplicate invoice uploads.
Additive columns and indexes for PAN protection, webhook idempotency leases, and payout reconciliation.
Additive columns for structured KYC names, consent tracking, and payout admin approval workflows.
Additive columns and AdminSession table for dual admin roles and single-active session enforcement.
Additive GlobalRewardPool table and providerRegisteredName column.
Additive providerNameVerified column on PaymentAccount.

breakingChanges: ALTER TABLE RewardRule DROP COLUMN monthlyPoolLimit
migrations.description: Destructive schema migration: removes obsolete RewardPool and GlobalRewardPool tables and monthlyPoolLimit column.

breakingChanges: ALTER TABLE RewardRule DROP COLUMN minRedemptionAmount
ALTER TABLE RewardRule DROP COLUMN maxRedemptionAmount
ALTER TABLE RedemptionSettings DROP COLUMN minimumAmount
ALTER TABLE RedemptionSettings DROP COLUMN maximumAmount
migrations.description: Destructive schema migration: removes deprecated min/max redemption amount limits from RewardRule and RedemptionSettings.
Additive PushToken and PushCampaign tables for notification subsystem.
Additive unique compound index on RewardRule(profession, version).
Drops default percentage on RewardRule, adds minimumRedemptionAmount, adds account deletion fields to User, and enforces two-admin uniqueness.
Destructive enum migration: removes legacy 'ADMIN' value from UserRole PostgreSQL enum, enforcing strict separation of BILL_ADMIN and OPERATIONS_ADMIN.
Additive tables AppInstallation and AccountDeletionOperation for installation tracking and asynchronous deletion state machine.
Adds claim tracking columns to AppInstallation and database-level lease fencing fields (leaseOwner, leaseVersion, leaseExpiresAt) to AccountDeletionOperation.
Adds destructiveStartedAt column and partial unique index on AccountDeletionOperation for active operations per user.
Retires legacy seeded default reward and GST rules, and adds failedPasswordAttempts and lockedUntil to User for persistent account lockout.
Ensures any existing redemption settings without valid dates or threshold are safely disabled (fail-closed).
Additive column beneficiaryBlindIndex and unique index on PaymentAccount to prevent cross-user account linking.
Indexes on Payout foreign keys, removes CASCADE on financial history in favor of RESTRICT, and adds non-negative balance CHECK constraints.
Additive columns statutoryRetentionExpiresAt and legalHold on User, indexes, and removes CASCADE on KycRecord and PaymentAccount in favor of RESTRICT.
Additive column upiIdEncrypted on PaymentAccount for AES-256-GCM encrypted UPI address storage.
Additive bill revisions and cancellation fields, partial unique indexes for invoice resubmission, RESTRICT on Wallet.userId foreign key, and totalRedeemed non-negative check.

Additive maximumRedemptionAmount on RedemptionSettings, composite query performance indexes on WalletTransaction, User, PaymentAccount, and Payout, and PostgreSQL trigger enforcing append-only immutability on AuditLog.
Additive deficitLiability column on Wallet to model delayed gateway reconciliation liabilities, and restores check constraint chk_wallet_available_balance_non_negative.
